claim_boundary: Held-out observation audit plus full-corpus coverage; it does not validate an unlabelled connector.

metric_definitions.profile_organisations: Distinct organisations with a usable organisation_number; the denominator for every coverage ratio.
metric_definitions.profiles_missing_organisation_number: Profile rows skipped because their organisation_number is missing or not a digit string.
metric_definitions.labelled_observations: Distinct audit label ids read from --labels.
metric_definitions.audited_observations: Observation rows that have an audit label.
metric_definitions.published_audited: Validator-accepted audited rows whose label says exact_entity is truthy.
metric_definitions.unlabelled_publishable_observations: Validator-accepted rows with no audit label; they can never be published.
metric_definitions.wrong_entity_publications: Canonical definition: published rows whose audit label is not exact_entity (0 while publication is exact-entity gated).
metric_definitions.unsupported_publications: Canonical definition: published rows that fail validate_observation; structurally 0 because published rows are validator-accepted.
metric_definitions.metric_precision: Canonical definition: published rows the audit marked metric_correct / published rows.
metric_definitions.withheld_wrong_entity_rows: Validator-accepted audited rows that are not published because the audit could not confirm the exact legal entity.
metric_definitions.accepted_entity_yield: published / validator-accepted audited rows: the share of publishable rows that survive the exact-entity audit.
metric_definitions.sentiment_audited: Published rows that carry a truthy sentiment label.
metric_definitions.sentiment_accuracy: sentiment_correct audited rows / sentiment_audited rows; null when no sentiment row was audited.
metric_definitions.coverage: Per-field organisation coverage over the profile organisation set, computed with the same rules and signal sets as scripts/evaluate_external_footprint.py.
metric_definitions.recall_proxy_50: Mean of the six scored coverage ratios (RECALL_PROXY_FIELDS) multiplied by 50 (a proxy: the official Recall/50 field weights are not documented in this tree). `workforce_snapshot` is reported but excluded.
metric_definitions.direct_reviewer_gaps: Organisations with at least one published row per gap kind: social_profile=profile_handle, dated_news=public_post with a publication date, hiring=job_posting.
metric_definitions.dated_news: Organisations with a published public_post row whose date is in metrics.published_at, metrics.published_date or a top-level published_at; BRREG announcements dated only in signal.date are excluded because they are registry events, not news.
metric_definitions.direct_reviewer_gap_ratios: direct_reviewer_gaps divided by the profile organisation count.
metric_definitions.direct_reviewer_gap_base_profiles: Profile organisation count used as the gap denominator.
metric_definitions.dated_registry_announcements: Organisations with a published public_post row on the brreg platform that carries a date in signal.date.
metric_definitions.dated_registry_announcements_ratio: dated_registry_announcements divided by the profile organisation count.
metric_definitions.minimum_audit: Minimum number of audit labels requested on the command line.
metric_definitions.audit_size_gate: True when the number of audit labels reaches minimum_audit.
